capabilities: Manage tasks from multiple Markdown files as switchable boards
View the same task file as a board, list, calendar, or dashboard
Write checkbox, lane, and detail changes back to the Markdown file
Configure lanes, task details, and optional assignees with avatars
Scaffold task and people files with one-click quick setup
extras: README notes tasks follow a documented format with downloadable sample files (TASKS.sample.md, People.sample.md) and states the plugin avoids Node/Electron APIs so it works on mobile.
problem: Obsidian task checkboxes have no board, calendar, or dashboard view, and users juggling several task files have no way to switch between them as separate boards.
summary: Task manager that reads Markdown task files and displays them as a Kanban board, list, month calendar, or stats dashboard, writing checkbox changes back to the file.
